title: Affine extension and sections respect the unit with independent universes
statement: Let $g:Y\prime\to Y$ be a morphism of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $Q\in D_{QCoh}(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Allow independent module and sheaf localization universes. Write $G_Z=R\Gamma_Z$, $S_g=\operatorname{res}_g$, $T_g=\operatorname{ext}_g$ for the fixed functors and adjunction [lem-sc-mixed-global-extension-adjunction], and $c_g:Rg_*;G_Y\cong G_{Y\prime};S_g$ for the normalized Leray comparison [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso]. There exists an isomorphism $a:T_g(G_YQ)\cong G_{Y\prime}(Lg^*Q)$ with $\eta_T(G_YQ);S_g(a)=G_Y(\eta_g(Q));(c_g)_{Lg^*Q}$. This is the fixed pullback/direct-image unit, with no flatness or boundedness hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 06Z0, 08DV, 08DW and 0AA7: affine equivalence, K-flat tilde, affine pullback, canonical scalar-extension adjunct

proof.text: Identify both affine schemes with their canonical spectra. Apply the affine quasi-coherent derived equivalence to Q and represent its inverse by a K-flat module complex. Exact tilde gives Q and its K-flat representative.
Apply the natural tilde/pullback formula on the K-flat representative. Derived sections and the affine counit identify its pullback with derived extension of its module of sections.

The extension and tensor-pullback adjunction units agree on the complexes. Descend through each localization and compare left adjoints to the fixed scalar restriction. This transports the comparison to mixedGlobalExtensionAdjunction including its unit. The normalized right-derived-unit equation identifies its right comparison with mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g. Thus obtain precisely the asserted unit equality, without equating the localization universes.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_mixedExtensionSectionsUnit
    {Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y'] (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hQ : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y Q) :
    ∃ a : (mixedGlobalExtension g).obj ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y).obj Q) ≅
        (schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y').obj ((derivedPullback g).obj Q),
      (mixedGlobalExtensionAdjunction g).unit.app ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y).obj Q) ≫
          (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map a.hom =
        (schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y).map ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction g).unit.app Q) ≫
          (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g).hom.app ((derivedPullback g).obj Q)
